key_insight: OvAi Focus combines AI segmentation and morphology extraction to make gynecological ultrasound interpretation of healthy ovaries and adnexal masses more objective.
clinical_relevance: By standardizing how ovarian structures and mass features are identified, the framework could support more consistent ultrasound reporting in ovarian cancer assessment.
method: Segmentation module identifies healthy ovaries plus solid and cystic components of adnexal masses.
Morphology module extracts IOTA-based keywords describing adnexal mass features.
Outputs were compared against ground-truth masks and interobserver agreement measures.
evidence_signal: In the abstract, segmentation DICE scores ranged from 0.62 for functional ovary to 0.87 for the whole adnexal mass, while morphology agreement showed Fleiss Kappa of 0.16 to 0.57 and percent agreement of 47% to 90%.
watch_item: Performance is variable across targets, and the morphology module still depends on subjective reference labels and clinical validation before routine use.
paper_title: OvAi Focus: A framework for multiclass segmentation and morphological features extraction in gynecological ultrasound
